title: Medication Supply Days Remaining
dataSources: Pump telemetry (`health:glucose`), lab results (`health:lab`), therapy sessions (`health:pt`), symptom diaries (`health:symptom`), care tasks (`health:ops`).
app: Chronic-condition self-management telemetry — insulin-pump events, A1c lab imports, physical-therapy rep logs, and symptom diaries — streamed to Splunk HEC via device exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=health:ops medication_name=* supply_exhaust_epoch=* active=*
| eval days_left=round((supply_exhaust_epoch-now())/86400,1)
| where active="yes"
| table medication_name active days_left
| sort days_left
description: Lists open medication supplies with time remaining for medication coverage.
value: Time-left monitoring helps prevent quiet deadline misses across the operational details that support medication coverage.
implementation: Store an expiry timestamp on `health:ops` events and filter for open or unfinished medication supplies.
visualization: Table of open medication supplies sorted by time remaining.
grandmaExplanation: It turns which medication supplies are about to run out of time so you can deal with them before medication coverage slips.
